source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: For an ASTRA MILITARUM **[Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction)**, OFFICER models with this ability may issue Orders. The number of Orders an OFFICER can give in each **[battle round](vsdata:core-rule/start-of-battle-round)**, and the units allowed to receive them, are set by its datasheet. For each Order, choose which Order from the list that follows, then pick an eligible friendly unit up to 6" from the issuing OFFICER model. OFFICER models give Orders during your **[Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase)**, and also at the close of any phase in which they got out of a TRANSPORT or were placed on the battlefield. An Order affects its unit until your next Command phase starts. Unless a rule specifies otherwise, a unit keeps only one Order and a later Order supersedes the earlier one. **[Battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)** units cannot be issued Orders, and an Order stops affecting a unit that becomes Battle-shocked. Only the ASTRA MILITARUM models in that unit benefit from an Order. **MOVE! MOVE! MOVE**!: +3" Move. **FIX BAYONETS**!: melee weapons improve their Weapon Skill by 1. **TAKE AIM**!: +1 to the Ballistic Skill of ranged weapons. **FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE**!: Rapid Fire weapons improve their Attacks by 1. **TAKE COVER**!: Save improves by 1, but not past 3+. **DUTY AND HONOUR**!: Leadership and Objective Control improve by 1.

orders.name: FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!
